news.title: New K9 finds narcotics during traffic stop
news.summary: A traffic stop in Cartersville led to a woman’s arrest for narcotics possession, all thanks to a new K9 on the job, the Cartersville Police Dept. said.

news.title: Woman raped by three men during Halloween event at downtown Athens country bar, police report says
news.summary: The woman told police she encountered a man dressed as the Joker who offered to buy her a drink. After she declined, the man allegedly grabbed her by the arm.

news.title: What we know about Nick Graham, Lakewood Police agent killed in shooting
news.summary: Lakewood Police are mourning the loss of Agent Nicholas Alan Graham, who died in a shooting that also injured four others, including three agents.

news.title: Arrest made in death of Atlanta man after fight outside Nashville bar
news.summary: Nashville police arrested Keith A. King Jr. for the October homicide of Torey Ward following a fight outside a bar.

news.title: Rockdale County High School shooting threat found to be hoax
news.summary: Authorities confirmed a social media threat against Rockdale County High School was a hoax originating in Wisconsin.

news.title: Family remembers Gwinnett brothers shot, killed during vape sale
news.summary: The family of two teenagers gunned down in Lawrenceville is remembering the two brothers who were shot and killed on Wednesday during a vape sale turned wrong.

news.title: DA releases more details about shooting where Newnan officer killed 18-year-old
news.summary: Here's a breakdown of what the DA's office, the Georgia Bureau of Investigation, and the family and attorneys all said happened.

news.title: Juvenile, 18-year-old hurt in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: APD said the two were taken to the hospital.

news.title: APD: Suspects hid under porch and opened fire on man, woman
news.summary: The two who were shot were taken to the hospital. Police established a perimeter around the home as they actively searched for the suspects.

news.title: All I-75/85 lanes reopen at North Ave after police activity
news.summary: Traffic is flowing again along the Downtown Connector after earlier police activity shut down Interstate 75/85 at North Avenue for roughly two hours Friday night.

news.title: 3 injured, including juvenile, after shootout at SW Atlanta apartments
news.summary: An 18-year-old man and a juvenile are among three people hospitalized after a shootout at a southwest Atlanta apartment complex Friday night, according to police.

news.title: Active standoff after suspects shoot 2 from under Vine City porch, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police have surrounded a Vine City home after suspects hiding under a front porch opened fire Friday night, injuring a man and a woman.

news.title: College Park police seize drugs, guns, and cash in 'Operation Zero Tolerance' sweeps
news.summary: Surveillance at a local motel and targeted neighborhood patrols lead to arrests, weapons seizures, and a bust of trafficking-quantity drugs.

news.title: Lithonia man sentenced to life after shooting girlfriend through motel window on 911 call
news.summary: A jury convicted 38-year-old Antonio Robert Watson of malice murder, three counts of felony murder, aggravated assault, first-degree home invasion, and gun charges.

news.title: Woman dies days after being shot, pulled from car in Atlanta: police
news.summary: An attack that started with a woman being shot inside a car and pulled onto a southwest Atlanta street has become a murder investigation after she died at the hospital, Atlanta police said.
